simple.meaning: חֲצֵרוֹת (Chătsêrôwth) is a place-name in the Hebrew text (H2698). BibleIQ follows its 6 occurrences across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This place appears in Numbers, Deuteronomy, beginning at Numbers 11:35. The surrounding context includes wilderness, Israel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to the Hebrew place-name חֲצֵרוֹת (H2698).
simple.whyItMatters: Places in Scripture often connect geography, covenant history, judgment, worship, and movement through the land. BibleIQ keeps the place tied to its actual verse trail.
